# Cart fixtures

The edge-case fixtures are copied from pico-lsp `pkg/cart/testdata` for
byte-preserving save tests. `real_helloworld.p8` comes from
[apa64/try-pico8](https://github.com/apa64/try-pico8) at
`21bdc11a123db0626e304ef8e5ba9e483c080440` under the MIT license preserved in
`apa64__try-pico8.LICENSE`.

`.gitattributes` disables text conversion so the CRLF fixture stays CRLF.
